recordShape.secondary: array of the same position correspondence shape
recordShape.reachablePositions: array of {positionId, knowledgeState: CONDITIONAL_PROJECTION, conditions, evidenceRefs}
recordShape.unknown: array of unresolved questions or missing evidence
recordShape.observationTargets: array of STRUCTURAL_KNOWLEDGE targets that are not OBSERVED_SIGNAL until evidence is admitted

rules: No entity receives a position only from a date coordinate.
No entity receives a single global position when subsystems support materially different correspondences.
A current correspondence is a DERIVED_RUNTIME_READOUT, never an observed fact.
A future reachable position is CONDITIONAL_PROJECTION, never a prediction.
UNKNOWN is a valid governed output and must remain field-scoped.
Historical precedents may support interpretation but never determine current or future correspondence.
Observation targets remain STRUCTURAL_KNOWLEDGE until admitted current evidence supports them as OBSERVED_SIGNAL.
Observation-threshold criteria are qualitative and human-governed; no machine score can establish a crossing.
Reachable positions require an admitted current position, transition evidence, threshold review, explicit conditions, and CONDITIONAL_PROJECTION state.

admission.reason: The 48-position structural backbone is now canonical, but entity-level correspondence requires evidence admission and human review.

w6.pipeline: CURRENT_EVIDENCE -> RRE -> POSITION_CANDIDATE -> HUMAN_ADMISSION -> TRANSITION_SIGNAL -> OBSERVATION_THRESHOLD -> REACHABLE_POSITION
